headline: Former OpenAI safety leader David Robinson says OpenAI kept warning about dangers while still deploying models.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept; interview read in full, the headline matches the quotes.
importance_line: A former safety-team leader's account of the gap between warnings and deployment affects the AI safety debate and the public, but it is one person's view and OpenAI did not reply to the request for comment.
summary: Our 3 Oct edition carried a Business Insider report that David Robinson, a leader on OpenAI's Safety Systems team, had left the company. Now Business Insider reports, citing his interview with Ezra Klein, host of The Ezra Klein Show at The New York Times, that Robinson says he left because OpenAI kept publishing warnings about dangerous models while still training and deploying them; OpenAI did not respond to a request for comment.
notes: Interview date not stated; NEW. Robinson left OpenAI 'last week' per the article. Quotes are his own view.
